flows.title: Create a feature flag
steps: Go to the Features page and create a feature flag.
Enter the Feature Key, which is what the application references. It cannot be changed later.
Once the feature is created, GrowthBook shows instructions for using it in the application. Cmd+K opens the command palette to jump to any feature.

flows.title: Create an experiment
steps: Go to the Experiments page and click Add → Create New Experiment.
In the creation modal, enter the Name and the Hypothesis, and choose the Assignment Attribute. A Project, a Template and a Holdout are optional; a Template pre-fills settings.
GrowthBook creates the experiment as a draft with two default variations.

On the draft's Overview tab, work through the pre-launch checklist: select a data source and experiment assignment table, add at least one goal metric, and add a linked Feature Flag, Visual Editor change or URL Redirect.

flows.title: Import an experiment run elsewhere
steps: On the Experiment page, select Create Experiment, then Import. This needs a connected data warehouse with experiment assignment queries.
GrowthBook lists the experiments it finds in those queries. If one is missing, deselect Hide Imported, or click Full Refresh in the bottom right.
Choose Import for the experiment, then review and confirm its metadata: the name, the variations and their splits, and the start date.
